facts.text: The Rockstar Room is a deluxe room designed around the hotel's Riot House history, with floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the Sunset Strip.
facts.excerpt: Immerse yourself in the history of Riot House when you choose this deluxe room uniquely designed with a rockstar in mind. This generously appointed space offers bespoke details, one king bed and floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the Sunset Strip.

facts.text: Sunset Boulevard View rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows and a separate sunroom area with a desk.
facts.excerpt: Spread out and relax high above the excitement of the Sunset Strip in this room featuring floor-to-ceiling windows, a king bed, a spacious bathroom and a separate sunroom area with a desk.

facts.text: Hollywood Hills View rooms look out over the Hollywood Hills.
facts.excerpt: a plush king bed, spacious bathroom and a large desk—with views of the Hollywood Hills just outside

facts.text: The Presidential Suite was designed by Jonathan Adler, with furnishings from his Modern American Glamour Collection.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy this suite designed by Jonathan Adler, featuring an upholstered king bed and furnishings from his Modern American Glamour Collection.

facts.text: The Panorama Suite has views of the Sunset Strip, the Hollywood Hills and downtown Los Angeles, with two bedrooms and a private balcony.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy iconic views of the Sunset Strip, Hollywood Hills, and downtown Los Angeles from this luxury lifestyle suite featuring two bedrooms, two full baths, a half bath, private balcony

facts.text: The Penthouse Suite has views of the Hollywood Hills and a private balcony.
facts.excerpt: Surrounded by magnificent views of the Hollywood Hills, enjoy the plush king bed, private balcony, floor-to-ceiling windows

facts.text: The Andaz Suite King has a marble bath with a separate rain shower and a tub.
facts.excerpt: Relax in style with a king bed, marble bath with separate rain shower and a tub, and a spacious living area complete with a dining table and workstation.
